docs.title: 🎣 Custom Fishing
docs.text:
Fishing on ArteryX is more than catching vanilla fish.

The Custom Fishing system adds custom fish, fishing levels, Entropy, Augments, Deliveries, Totems, Scales, Gutting, Baits, Skills, Fishing Tournaments, special fish, custom fishing mobs, and more.

Whether you want to make money, level up your fishing, collect rare fish, compete in tournaments, or build the strongest fishing rod possible, there is always something to work toward.

🎣 Custom Fish

6 Tiers

💰 Money

$100,000 Daily Limit

🔮 Entropy

Fishing Currency

⚡ Augments

Upgrade Your Rod

🗼 Totems

Passive Fishing Bonuses

🏆 Tournaments

Compete For Rewards

docs.title: 🎣 Getting Started
docs.text:
The easiest way to begin is simply to fish.

Use:

/fish menu

to open the main fishing menu.

You can also use the individual fishing commands explained throughout this guide.

You will need:

  • A fishing rod
  • A place where you can fish
  • Space in your inventory for catches
  • Patience
  • A willingness to build your fishing setup over time

As you fish, you will catch Custom Fish.

Custom Fish are different from normal Minecraft fish and are the main progression item for ArteryX's fishing system.

Higher-tier fish are rarer and generally provide better rewards.

docs.title: 🐟 Custom Fish Tiers
docs.text:
ArteryX uses six Custom Fish tiers.

Tier Rarity General Purpose 🥉 Bronze Common Starter fishing 🥈 Silver Uncommon Early progression 🥇 Gold Rare Mid-game fishing 💎 Diamond Very Rare Advanced fishing 💠 Platinum Extremely Rare High-end fishing 🌠 Mythical Legendary End-game fishing

Your fishing progression is not only about money.

Higher-tier fish can also provide more:

  • Entropy
  • Fishing XP
  • Delivery value
  • Collection progress
  • Tournament potential

docs.title: 💰 Fishing Money
docs.text:
Custom Fish can be sold through the fishing shop.

Use:

/fish shop

to open the Fishing Shop.

From there, you can sell eligible fish and receive money.

Warning

ArteryX has a $50,000 daily fishing money limit.

Once you reach the daily limit, you cannot continue generating fishing money until the limit resets.

The limit is designed to keep fishing profitable without allowing it to completely replace the rest of the ArteryX economy.

docs.title: 🔮 Entropy
docs.text:
Entropy is the main special currency used by the fishing system.

Unlike normal money, Entropy is mainly used for fishing progression.

It is used for things such as:

  • Crafting Augments
  • Upgrading fishing progression
  • Fishing system upgrades
  • Other advanced fishing features

You can check your fishing statistics using:

/fish stats

Entropy can be earned in several ways.

docs.title: 🎣 Catching Fish
docs.text:
Catching Custom Fish gives Entropy.

Generally, rarer fish provide more Entropy.

docs.title: ⚔️ Gutting Fish
docs.text:
You can sacrifice Custom Fish for Entropy using:

/fish gut

This permanently destroys the fish.

docs.title: 📦 Deliveries
docs.text: Completing fishing Deliveries can provide Entropy along with other rewards.

docs.title: 🏆 Tournaments
docs.text: Fishing Tournaments can also provide Entropy and other rewards.

docs.title: 👥 Fishing With Others
docs.text: Party Fishing can provide additional benefits when multiple players fish together.

docs.title: ⚔️ Gutting Fish
docs.text:
Gutting is a way to turn fish you do not want to keep into Entropy.

Open:

/fish gut

or access the Gutting Station through the fishing menu.

Place your fish inside the menu and confirm by closing the menu.

The fish will be destroyed and you will receive its Entropy reward.

Warning

Gutting is permanent.

Once a fish has been gutted, you cannot recover it.

Before gutting valuable fish, check whether the fish could be more useful for:

  • Deliveries
  • Selling
  • Tournaments
  • Collection
  • Trading

docs.title: 🔪 Precision Cutting
docs.text:
The Precision Cutting Augment improves the amount of Entropy you receive when gutting fish.

This makes it particularly useful if your main goal is building an Entropy-heavy fishing setup.

For the best results, combine your fishing progression with:

  • Precision Cutting
  • Fishing Skills
  • Entropy bonuses
  • High-tier fish

docs.title: ⚖️ Fish Scales
docs.text:
Scales are a risk-versus-reward feature.

Use:

/fish scales

to open the Scales menu.

You place a Custom Fish into the menu and choose a risk level.

The system then changes the fish's selling value.

You can potentially increase the value of your fish, but you can also lose value.

docs.title: Risk Levels
docs.text: Risk Chance of Profit Possible Change 🪶 Low 70% ±20% ⚙️ Medium 60% ±40% 🔥 High 50% ±60% 💀 Extreme 40% ±80%

docs.title: Low
docs.text:
The safest option.

You have the highest chance of increasing the fish's value, but the possible increase is smaller.

docs.title: Medium
docs.text:
A balanced option.

You accept more risk for a potentially larger increase.

docs.title: High
docs.text: A risky option for players who are willing to gamble more of the fish's value.

docs.title: Extreme
docs.text:
The biggest gamble.

You have the lowest chance of a profitable result, but the potential change in value is much larger.

Warning

Do not scale valuable fish blindly.

A bad roll can reduce the value of your fish.

docs.title: 🧩 Augments
docs.text:
Augments are special upgrades for your fishing rod.

They work similarly to custom fishing enchantments.

You can view the available Augments with:

/fish augments

Augments allow you to specialize your rod for different playstyles.

Some focus on:

  • More fish
  • Better fish
  • More Entropy
  • More XP
  • More money
  • Better gutting
  • Better custom mob chances
  • Better Scales results
  • Special weather effects

docs.title: 🔨 How To Craft An Augment
docs.text:
Augments are crafted using their required ingredients and Entropy.

The general process is:

docs.title: 1. Check the Augment
docs.text:
Use:

/fish augments

Find the Augment you want and check its requirements.

docs.title: 2. Get The Required Materials
docs.text:
Every Augment has its own recipe.

Recipes can require normal Minecraft items as well as special fishing items.

docs.title: 3. Make Sure You Have Enough Entropy
docs.text: Entropy is taken from your fishing balance when crafting.

docs.title: 4. Craft The Augment
docs.text:
Follow the recipe shown by the fishing system.

Once crafted, the Augment becomes available to apply to your fishing rod.

docs.title: 🎣 Applying Augments
docs.text:
Use:

/fish augment

The Augment menu allows you to apply your crafted Augments to a fishing rod.

Place:

  • Your fishing rod
  • The Augment

into the appropriate GUI slots.

Confirm the operation.

Your rod will receive the Augment.

docs.title: 🧹 Removing Augments
docs.text:
If you want to remove Augments from your rod, use the Augment menu.

Removing Augments costs Entropy.

Warning

Removing an Augment is not something you should do randomly.

Plan your rod before investing heavily into Augments.

docs.title: ⚡ ArteryX Augments
docs.text:
ArteryX currently uses the following Augments.

Augment Unlock Level Max Level Base Cost 🌊 Hot Spot 10 13 50,000 Entropy ⛈️ Call of the Storm 12 5 40,000 Entropy 🍗 Saturate 12 5 35,000 Entropy 📚 Sage 12 12 57,500 Entropy 🌎 Biome Disruption 16 3 60,000 Entropy 🔪 Precision Cutting 22 22 70,000 Entropy 🦀 Crab Bait 25 25 40,000 Entropy 🧠 Intellect 25 25 50,000 Entropy 👁️ Perception 28 28 75,000 Entropy 🏆 Trophy 35 35 60,000 Entropy ☀️ Solar Rage 35 5 75,000 Entropy 🎣 Master Fisherman 45 45 120,000 Entropy

Note

The level shown above is the maximum configured level for that Augment, while the unlock level determines when you can begin using it.

docs.title: 🌊 Hot Spot
docs.text:
Hot Spot gives you a chance to catch additional fish.

Higher levels increase the chance.

Configured progression:

Level 1  → 6%
Level 2  → 11%
Level 3  → 15%
Level 4  → 19%
Level 5  → 25%

Additional levels continue through the configured Hot Spot progression.

Hot Spot is a strong choice for players who want:

  • More fish
  • More Entropy
  • More delivery progress
  • More chances at rare catches

docs.title: ⛈️ Call of the Storm
docs.text:
Call of the Storm improves your fishing while it is raining.

Configured values:

Level 1 → 5%
Level 2 → 15%
Level 3 → 25%
Level 4 → 35%
Level 5 → 50%

This is particularly useful for players who want to build around weather-based fishing.

docs.title: 🍗 Saturate
docs.text:
Saturate gives you a chance to restore hunger while fishing.

Configured values:

Level 1 → 5%
Level 2 → 10%
Level 3 → 20%
Level 4 → 30%
Level 5 → 50%

This is primarily a quality-of-life Augment.

docs.title: 📚 Sage
docs.text:
Sage increases your Fishing XP.

Configured progression:

1.03x
1.08x
1.12x
1.18x
1.25x
1.30x
1.35x
1.40x
1.425x

Sage is useful for players focused on leveling their fishing progression.

docs.title: 🌎 Biome Disruption
docs.text:
Biome Disruption gives you a chance to catch fish from other biome pools.

Configured values:

Level 1 → 15%
Level 2 → 40%
Level 3 → 65%

This is extremely useful when you are hunting fish that normally require different fishing environments.

docs.title: 🔪 Precision Cutting
docs.text:
Precision Cutting improves the Entropy earned from gutting fish.

It is designed for players who frequently use:

/fish gut

If your goal is to generate large amounts of Entropy, this is one of the most important Augments to consider.

docs.title: 🦀 Crab Bait
docs.text:
Crab Bait increases your chance of encountering fishing-related custom mobs such as Crabs.

Crabs are important because their drops can be used throughout the fishing progression system.

docs.title: 🧠 Intellect
docs.text:
Intellect improves the XP you gain from fishing.

This is useful when your main objective is leveling rather than directly maximizing money.

docs.title: 👁️ Perception
docs.text:
Perception improves the Entropy gained from catching fish.

This makes it especially useful for players who want to build an Entropy-focused rod without relying entirely on gutting.

docs.title: 🏆 Trophy
docs.text:
Trophy improves your results when using the Scales system.

If you frequently use:

/fish scales

Trophy becomes more valuable because it improves the effectiveness of your scaling strategy.

docs.title: ☀️ Solar Rage
docs.text:
Solar Rage improves the money generated from selling fish.

This is one of the most direct money-focused Augments.

It pairs naturally with:

  • High-tier fish
  • Scales
  • Fishing Shop
  • Fishing money limits

docs.title: 🎣 Master Fisherman
docs.text:
Master Fisherman is a late-game fishing Augment designed to improve your overall fishing performance and chances of obtaining higher-tier fish.

It requires a significantly higher Fishing Level and Entropy investment than early-game Augments.

docs.title: 🪱 Baits
docs.text:
Baits are specialized fishing items that can be used to focus your fishing setup toward different fish groups.

ArteryX currently includes multiple bait types.

Bait Unlock Level Uses Starter Bait 1 50 Freshwater Bait 5 50 Ocean Bait 10 50 Rare Bait 20 50 Frozen Bait 25 50 Deepsea Bait 30 50 Nether Bait 35 50 Legendary Bait 45 40 Celestial Bait 60 30

Baits are designed to help you target different groups of fish instead of simply fishing randomly.

docs.title: 📦 Deliveries
docs.text:
Deliveries are fishing orders.

They give you a reason to keep your fish instead of immediately selling or gutting everything you catch.

Use:

/fish deliveries

to access the Delivery system.

docs.title: 📦 How Deliveries Work
docs.text:
The basic process is:

Catch Custom Fish
        ↓
Unlock Delivery
        ↓
Check Required Fish
        ↓
Collect The Required Fish
        ↓
Start The Delivery
        ↓
Wait For Completion
        ↓
Collect Your Rewards

ArteryX requires 150 Custom Fish to progress to a new Delivery.

Warning

Only Custom Fish count toward Delivery progression.

Normal vanilla fish do not count.

docs.title: 🐟 Why You Should Save Fish
docs.text:
It can be tempting to sell every fish you catch.

However, Deliveries may require specific fish.

Before selling or gutting large quantities of fish, check your current Delivery.

Sometimes keeping a fish is more valuable than immediately selling it.

docs.title: ⏱️ Delivery Times
docs.text:
Different Delivery types have different completion times.

The configured timers include:

Delivery Time 1 30 seconds 2 1 minute 3 2 minutes 4 1 minute 5 2 minutes 6 4 minutes 7 15 minutes

The required fish and rewards depend on the Delivery.

docs.title: 🎁 Delivery Rewards
docs.text:
Deliveries can reward you with special fishing items.

Rewards can include:

  • 🦀 Crab Claws
  • 🦀 Crab Scales
  • 🐬 Dolphin Tails
  • 🦑 Squid Tentacles
  • 🔮 Entropy Crystals
  • 🎣 Platinum Lures
  • 🦀 Crab Lures
  • 🌠 Mythical Lures

Some deliveries provide stronger rewards than others.

docs.title: 🔮 Entropy Crystals
docs.text:
Entropy Crystals are physical items representing stored Entropy.

They are useful when you want to:

  • Store Entropy
  • Trade Entropy
  • Move Entropy between players
  • Receive Entropy as a Delivery reward

docs.title: 🗼 Fishing Totems
docs.text:
Fishing Totems are a mid-to-late-game fishing progression system.

They provide passive bonuses while you are fishing within their effective area.

The Totem system allows you to build a more advanced fishing setup rather than relying only on your fishing rod.

docs.title: 🧱 Building A Fishing Totem
docs.text:
Fishing Totems require special fishing materials.

The configured Totem system uses items such as:

  • Dolphin Tails
  • Crab Claws
  • Crab Scales
  • Squid Tentacles
  • High-tier fish

A Fishing Totem becomes available at the required Fishing Level.

Note

The Totem is intended as a progression feature, so you should not expect to build one immediately after joining the server.

docs.title: ⚙️ Totem Upgrades
docs.text:
Totems can provide multiple upgradeable properties.

The important upgrade categories are:

docs.title: 📏 Radius
docs.text:
Controls how far the Totem's effects can reach.

A larger radius means more area in which the Totem can benefit your fishing.

docs.title: ⏱️ Cooldown
docs.text: Reduces the time between Totem activations/effects.

docs.title: ⌛ Active Time
docs.text:
Increases how long the Totem remains active.

The exact upgrade cost and level information can be viewed through the Totem system in-game.

docs.title: 🌟 Totem Passives
docs.text:
Totem Passives are additional bonuses that can be added to your Fishing Totem.

ArteryX currently uses:

Passive Unlock Level Slots Purpose 🎓 Experienced Fisherman 20 1 Increased Fishing XP 🦀 Little Critters 40 2 Improves custom mob benefits 🐟 Fish School 40 3 Improves fishing bonuses 🎁 Random Drops 55 4 Chance for additional mob drops 💎 Treasure Hunter 60 3 Chance for valuable loot 🌊 Mythical Waters 60 5 Chance to improve fish tier 🌀 Entropy Hoarder 60 6 Increased Entropy

docs.title: 🎓 Experienced Fisherman
docs.text:
Provides a Fishing XP bonus while its Totem effect is active.

This is particularly useful when leveling your Fishing Level.

docs.title: 🦀 Little Critters
docs.text:
Improves the benefits associated with fishing-related custom mobs.

This is useful for players who actively hunt for:

  • Crab Claws
  • Crab Scales
  • Dolphin Tails
  • Squid Tentacles

docs.title: 🐟 Fish School
docs.text:
Improves fishing-related bonus effects.

This passive works well with a fishing setup focused on catching more fish.

docs.title: 🎁 Random Drops
docs.text:
Gives you a chance to receive additional fishing-related mob drops.

This can help supply the materials required for other fishing progression systems.

docs.title: 💎 Treasure Hunter
docs.text:
Provides a chance to receive valuable additional loot while fishing.

It is aimed at players who want extra rewards beyond the fish themselves.

docs.title: 🌊 Mythical Waters
docs.text:
Provides a chance to improve the tier of fish you catch.

This makes it particularly valuable for players hunting:

  • Platinum
  • Mythical
  • Other high-tier fish

docs.title: 🌀 Entropy Hoarder
docs.text:
Increases the amount of Entropy you receive.

If your primary goal is building expensive Augments and progressing through fishing systems, this is one of the most useful Totem Passives.

docs.title: 🏆 Fishing Tournaments
docs.text:
Fishing Tournaments are competitive events where players compete against each other.

Tournament types can include objectives such as:

  • Catching the most fish
  • Catching the longest fish
  • Catching the shortest fish
  • Earning the most Entropy
  • Catching specific fish
  • Catching fish from different biomes
  • Longest casts
  • Total fish length

Each tournament has its own objective.

docs.title: 🥇 Tournament Rewards
docs.text: ArteryX's configured rewards are:

docs.title: 🥇 1st Place
docs.text:
2x Arcane Shard
$5,000

docs.title: 🥈 2nd Place
docs.text:
1x Arcane Shard
$3,000

docs.title: 🥉 3rd Place
docs.text:
Fishing Crate Key
$2,000

Participants can also receive an Entropy reward for taking part.

docs.title: 👥 Party Fishing
docs.text:
Fishing does not have to be a solo activity.

Party Fishing rewards players for fishing near each other.

The configured system uses:

Maximum players for full bonus: 5
Radius: 40 blocks

This means you can fish together with other players and benefit from the Party Fishing system.

It is a great way to turn fishing into a social activity.

docs.title: 🦀 Custom Fishing Mobs
docs.text:
Fishing can also trigger special custom mobs.

ArteryX currently uses custom fishing encounters such as:

docs.title: 🦀 Crab
docs.text:
Crabs can provide:

  • Crab Claws
  • Crab Scales

These materials are useful for fishing progression.

docs.title: 🐬 Dolphin
docs.text:
Dolphins can provide:

  • Dolphin Tails

docs.title: 🦑 Squid
docs.text:
Squids can provide:

  • Squid Tentacles

These materials can be used for fishing-related recipes, Deliveries and progression.

docs.title: 🎯 Fishing Skills
docs.text:
Fishing Skills provide additional progression alongside your Fishing Level.

Skill Points can be invested into fishing abilities.

Skills can improve different parts of the fishing system, such as:

  • Gutting
  • Entropy
  • Augments
  • Totems
  • Catching
  • Special fishing effects

Use the Fishing Skills menu to see the skills available to your character.

docs.title: 📊 Fishing Progression
docs.text:
A good general progression path is:

Start Fishing
      ↓
Catch Bronze & Silver Fish
      ↓
Earn Money + Entropy
      ↓
Level Up Fishing
      ↓
Unlock Better Baits
      ↓
Unlock Augments
      ↓
Improve Your Fishing Rod
      ↓
Unlock Totems
      ↓
Build Totem Passives
      ↓
Hunt Platinum & Mythical Fish
      ↓
Compete In Tournaments
      ↓
Build Your End-Game Fishing Setup

You do not need to unlock everything immediately.

The fishing system is designed to grow with you.

# 🐟 All Custom Fish

This page lists the Custom Fish currently available on ArteryX.

docs.title: 🥉 Bronze Fish
docs.text:
Bronze is the most common Custom Fish tier.

These fish are the foundation of your fishing progression and are commonly encountered while starting out.

Fish Tier 🐟 River Pike Bronze ✨ Glow Minnow Bronze 🟤 Copperfin Bronze 🌿 Marsh Perch Bronze

Bronze fish are useful for:

  • Early money
  • Entropy
  • Deliveries
  • Fishing XP
  • Learning the fishing system

Do not ignore Bronze fish just because they are common.

You will need large numbers of Custom Fish as you progress through Deliveries.

docs.title: 🥈 Silver Fish
docs.text:
Silver fish are less common than Bronze fish and provide better progression value.

Fish Tier 🌙 Moon Koi Silver 🫧 Pearlfin Silver ❄️ Frostscale Silver ⚡ Storm Eel Silver

Silver fish are useful for:

  • Better fishing income
  • More Entropy
  • Deliveries
  • Progressing toward stronger fishing setups

docs.title: 🥇 Gold Fish
docs.text:
Gold fish are rare catches and mark the beginning of more advanced fishing.

Fish Tier 🟡 Golden Koi Gold 🔥 Emberfin Gold 🦷 Deepfang Gold ☀️ Sunray Fish Gold

Gold fish are valuable for players progressing toward advanced fishing systems.

docs.title: 💎 Diamond Fish
docs.text:
Diamond fish are very rare.

Fish Tier ❄️ Frostfire Fish Diamond 🌊 Abyssfin Diamond 💠 Prism Koi Diamond ⚡ Stormray Diamond

Diamond fish are excellent catches for:

  • Money
  • Entropy
  • Deliveries
  • Collection
  • Fishing progression

docs.title: 💠 Platinum Fish
docs.text:
Platinum fish are among the rarest fish available through normal fishing.

Fish Tier 🌌 Voidfin Platinum 🔥 Inferno Koi Platinum ✨ Celestial Ray Platinum 🦈 Emperor Shark Platinum

Finding a Platinum fish should feel like a significant catch.

Keep them safe until you decide whether you want to:

  • Sell them
  • Use them for a Delivery
  • Use them for fishing progression
  • Keep them as collectibles
  • Use them with other fishing systems

docs.title: 🌠 Mythical Fish
docs.text:
Mythical is the highest Custom Fish tier.

These are extremely rare catches intended to be exciting end-game discoveries.

Fish Tier 🐉 Arteryx Leviathan Mythical 🐍 Abyssal Serpent Mythical ☀️ Solaris Fish Mythical 🔥 Netherfin Mythical

Finding a Mythical fish is one of the biggest moments in the Custom Fishing system.

If you catch one, do not immediately sell or gut it without checking whether you need it for another part of the fishing system.

docs.title: 📊 Fish Tier Overview
docs.text: Tier Difficulty Progression 🥉 Bronze Common Starter 🥈 Silver Uncommon Early 🥇 Gold Rare Mid 💎 Diamond Very Rare Advanced 💠 Platinum Extremely Rare End-Game 🌠 Mythical Legendary Highest

docs.title: 🎯 Why Fish Tiers Matter
docs.text:
Fish tiers affect how valuable a catch can be throughout the fishing system.

Higher-tier fish are generally more desirable because they can provide better:

  • Money
  • Entropy
  • Fishing XP
  • Collection value
  • Delivery value
  • Tournament potential

However, rarer does not always mean you should sell it immediately.

A rare fish may be more useful for a Delivery or another fishing objective.

docs.title: 📦 Fish & Deliveries
docs.text:
Some Deliveries require specific Custom Fish.

Before selling or gutting a rare fish, check:

/fish deliveries

If your current Delivery needs that fish, keeping it may be the better choice.

docs.title: ⚖️ Fish & Scales
docs.text:
Fish can be placed into:

/fish scales

to attempt to change their selling value.

The risk increases as you move from:

Low
↓
Medium
↓
High
↓
Extreme

Rare fish can produce larger monetary results, but they can also become less valuable after a bad Scales result.

docs.title: 🔪 Fish & Gutting
docs.text:
Any fish that is eligible for gutting can be converted into Entropy.

Use:

/fish gut

Remember:

Gutting destroys the fish.

Do not gut a rare fish before checking whether you need it elsewhere.

docs.title: 🏆 Fish & Tournaments
docs.text:
Some Fishing Tournaments can use fish-related objectives.

Depending on the tournament type, players may compete around:

  • Fish count
  • Fish length
  • Specific fish
  • Total length
  • Entropy
  • Other fishing statistics

This means even a fish that you would normally sell may become useful during a tournament.

docs.title: 🗼 Fish & Totems
docs.text:
Some fish and fishing-mob drops are useful for Totem progression.

Special fishing materials can be required when building or progressing your Fishing Totem.

This is another reason not to treat every fish-related item as simple sellable loot.

docs.title: 🧪 Fish-Related Special Drops
docs.text:
Custom Fishing also includes special fishing-related items obtained through custom mobs and other systems.

Important materials include:

Item Main Use 🦀 Crab Claw Fishing progression 🦀 Crab Scale Fishing progression 🐬 Dolphin Tail Fishing progression 🦑 Squid Tentacle Fishing progression 💎 Entropy Crystal Stored Entropy

These materials can be important for:

  • Augments
  • Deliveries
  • Totems
  • Other fishing progression

docs.title: 🔍 How To Discover Fish
docs.text:
The easiest way to explore the collection is:

/fish codex

The Codex is your in-game fishing encyclopedia.

Use it to discover fish, check their information, and work toward completing your collection.

docs.title: 🏅 Become A Master Angler

Collecting every fish is not just about money.

A complete fishing collection means you have explored the different parts of ArteryX's fishing system.

And eventually...

catch them all. 🎣

docs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
docs.text: Find quick answers to the most common questions about ArteryX.

docs.title: Can I trade paid ranks for in-game money?
docs.text:
Yes.

Players may trade paid ranks with other players using in-game money, as long as:

  • Both players agree to the trade.
  • The price is agreed upon by both players.
  • No real-money payment is involved.

Note

ArteryX staff are not responsible for player-to-player trades. Trade carefully.

docs.title: How do I earn money?
docs.text:
There are many ways to earn money on ArteryX:

  • OneBlock progression
  • Farming
  • Mining
  • Mob farming
  • Selling items
  • Player Shops
  • Auction House
  • Voting
  • Events
  • Custom server features

docs.title: How does OneBlock work?
docs.text:
Every player gets their own OneBlock island.

Break your OneBlock to progress through different phases and unlock new resources, blocks, and content.

Use:

/ob

to open the main OneBlock menu.

Useful commands include:

/ob upgrade
/ob phases
/ob settings
/ob warp
/ob level

docs.title: Can I upgrade my island?
docs.text:
Yes.

Use:

/ob upgrade

to upgrade your island size.

Your island starts at:

50 × 50

and can eventually be upgraded up to:

250 × 250

docs.title: Can I change my OneBlock phase?
docs.text:
Yes.

Use:

/ob phases

You can switch between phases that you have already unlocked.

docs.title: Are there Nether and End islands?
docs.text:
Yes.

ArteryX includes Nether and End OneBlock islands.

Both use the same island size system as your main island and are generated as void-style islands.

docs.title: Can I change my island settings?
docs.text:
Yes.

Use:

/ob settings

to view and configure the available island settings.

docs.title: Can I teleport to my island?
docs.text:
Yes.

Use:

/ob warp

to access your available island warps.

docs.title: Can I check my island level?
docs.text:
Yes.

Use:

/ob level

to view your island level and progression.

docs.title: Is Keep Inventory enabled?
docs.text:
No.

Keep Inventory is disabled on ArteryX.

Death can cause you to lose the items you were carrying, so keep valuable items stored safely.

docs.title: Can I PvP?
docs.text:
Yes.

PvP is allowed where enabled.

Keep Inventory is disabled, so PvP deaths can result in item loss.

docs.title: Is teleport killing allowed?
docs.text:
Yes.

Teleport killing is allowed on ArteryX.

If you accept a teleport request or teleport somewhere dangerous, you are responsible for the outcome.

docs.title: Is trapping allowed?
docs.text:
Yes.

Player trapping is allowed using normal gameplay mechanics.

However, exploits, cheats, or server-crashing methods are not allowed.

docs.title: Can I AFK?
docs.text:
Yes.

AFKing is allowed.

However, using auto-clickers, bots, macros, or other automation to perform gameplay actions is not allowed.

docs.title: Can I use mods?
docs.text:
Yes.

Client-side mods are allowed as long as they do not provide an unfair gameplay advantage or automate gameplay.

Generally allowed:

  • Sodium
  • Iris
  • OptiFine
  • Shaders
  • Replay Mod
  • Performance mods
  • Cosmetic mods
  • Client-side UI mods
  • Minimap mods without unfair features

Not allowed:

  • X-Ray
  • Kill Aura
  • Reach
  • Fly Hacks
  • Speed Hacks
  • Auto Mine
  • Auto Clickers
  • Combat automation
  • Gameplay automation
  • Any modification that provides an unfair advantage

If you are unsure about a mod, ask staff before using it.

docs.title: How do I get Crate Keys?
docs.text:
Crate Keys can be obtained through:

  • Voting
  • VoteParty
  • Events
  • Giveaways
  • Special rewards

docs.title: What happens if I get banned?
docs.text:
If you believe your punishment was incorrect, contact staff through Discord and open a support ticket.

Do not attempt to evade your punishment using another account.

docs.title: I found a bug. What should I do?
docs.text:
Report it privately to staff through Discord.

Do not abuse or share serious exploits.

docs.title: Where can I get help?
docs.text:
Join our Discord and open a support ticket if you need assistance.

Join Discord

docs.title: Server Rules
docs.text:
Play fair, respect others, and help keep ArteryX enjoyable for everyone.

Important

By joining ArteryX, you agree to follow these rules. Staff may take action against behavior that negatively affects the server, even if it is not specifically listed below.

docs.title: Respect Everyone
docs.text:
• Treat players and staff with respect.
  • Harassment, bullying, threats, and personal attacks are not allowed.
  • Hate speech and discrimination are prohibited.
  • Do not impersonate staff or other players.
  • Follow reasonable staff instructions.

docs.title: Fair Gameplay
docs.text:
Do not use cheats, exploits, or modifications that provide an unfair advantage.

Prohibited examples include:

  • X-Ray
  • Kill Aura
  • Reach
  • Fly Hacks
  • Speed Hacks
  • Combat Hacks
  • Auto Mine
  • Auto Clickers
  • Gameplay automation
  • Macros that automate gameplay
  • Duplication glitches
  • Exploiting server bugs

If you discover an exploit, report it instead of abusing it.

docs.title: Island Protection
docs.text:
Each player has their own OneBlock island.

Do not intentionally destroy or interfere with another player's island without permission.

Be careful when giving other players access to your island.

docs.title: Trapping
docs.text:
Trapping is allowed.

Players may create traps using normal gameplay mechanics.

However, you may not use:

  • Bugs
  • Exploits
  • Cheats
  • Server-crashing methods

docs.title: Teleport Killing
docs.text:
Teleport killing is allowed.

If you accept a teleport request or teleport somewhere dangerous, you are responsible for the outcome.

Do not exploit teleport mechanics to bypass server protections.

docs.title: PvP Rules
docs.text:
PvP is allowed where enabled.

Because Keep Inventory is disabled, dying in PvP may result in losing your items.

Do not use cheats, exploits, or unfair modifications during PvP.

docs.title: Griefing & Theft
docs.text:
Do not intentionally destroy or steal from protected player areas.

Respect:

  • Player islands
  • Community builds
  • Spawn
  • Server infrastructure
  • Protected areas

Normal PvP, trapping, and competition are allowed where permitted by the server.

docs.title: Alternate Accounts
docs.text:
Alternate accounts must not be used to gain unfair advantages.

Do not use alternate accounts to:

  • Evade punishments
  • Abuse rewards
  • Manipulate leaderboards
  • Exploit voting systems
  • Bypass server restrictions

docs.title: Keep Chat Respectful
docs.text:
• Be respectful.
  • Do not harass or bully players.
  • No hate speech or discrimination.
  • No threats.
  • No NSFW or sexually explicit content.
  • Do not intentionally disrupt chat.

docs.title: Swearing
docs.text:
Normal occasional swearing is allowed.

Excessive, targeted, or abusive language may result in punishment.

docs.title: Spam
docs.text:
Do not:

  • Flood chat.
  • Repeatedly send the same message.
  • Abuse CAPS.
  • Spam commands.
  • Intentionally disrupt conversations.

docs.title: Advertising
docs.text:
Do not advertise other Minecraft servers or communities without permission.

This includes:

  • Other Minecraft servers
  • Server IPs
  • Discord servers
  • Websites
  • Recruitment links

docs.title: Discord Rules
docs.text:
Minecraft rules also generally apply within the ArteryX Discord.

Additionally:

  • No ping spam.
  • No harassment.
  • No inappropriate profile content.
  • Do not abuse support tickets.
  • Use the correct channels.
  • Follow staff instructions.

docs.title: Economy Rules
docs.text:
Keep the economy fair.

The following are prohibited:

  • Duplication glitches
  • Economy exploits
  • Reward abuse
  • Chargeback fraud
  • Shop exploits
  • Automated economy abuse
  • Manipulating server systems for unfair profit

Player-to-player trading is allowed.

Always verify trades before completing them.

docs.title: AFK & Automation
docs.text:
AFKing is allowed.

However, automation that performs gameplay actions for you is not allowed.

docs.title: Not allowed:
docs.text:
• Auto Clickers
  • AFK Bots
  • Gameplay Macros
  • Automated Mining
  • Automated Combat
  • Scripts that perform gameplay actions

Simply being AFK is allowed.

docs.title: Client-Side Mods
docs.text: Client-side mods are allowed as long as they do not provide an unfair gameplay advantage or automate gameplay.

docs.title: Generally Allowed
docs.text:
• Sodium
  • Iris
  • OptiFine
  • Performance Mods
  • Shaders
  • Replay Mod
  • Cosmetic Mods
  • Client-side UI Mods
  • Minimap Mods without unfair features

docs.title: Not Allowed
docs.text:
• X-Ray
  • Kill Aura
  • Reach
  • Fly
  • Speed
  • Auto Clickers
  • Auto Mine
  • Combat Automation
  • Gameplay Automation
  • Any modification that provides an unfair advantage

If you are unsure about a modification, ask staff before using it.

docs.title: Exploits & Bugs
docs.text:
Do not intentionally abuse bugs or exploits.

This includes:

  • Duplication glitches
  • Economy exploits
  • Permission bypasses
  • Protection bypasses
  • Item duplication
  • Server-crashing exploits
  • Unintended mechanics used for unfair advantages

Report serious bugs privately to staff.

docs.title: Server Attacks
docs.text:
The following are strictly prohibited:

  • Intentionally crashing the server.
  • Attempting to overload the server.
  • DDoS attacks.
  • Intentionally creating extreme server lag.
  • Exploiting network vulnerabilities.
  • Sharing methods intended to damage the server.

docs.title: Staff Rules
docs.text:
Respect staff members.

If you believe a punishment was incorrect:

  1. Stay respectful.
  2. Open a Discord support ticket.
  3. Explain what happened.
  4. Provide evidence if available.

Do not start public arguments with staff.

docs.title: Punishment Guidelines
docs.text:
Offense Typical Punishment Chat Spam Warning → Mute Excessive Toxicity Warning → Mute Harassment Mute / Temporary Ban Advertising Temporary Ban X-Ray / Hacks Permanent Ban Auto Clicker Temporary Ban → Permanent Ban Duplication Exploits Temporary / Permanent Ban Serious Exploit Abuse Temporary / Permanent Ban Ban Evasion Permanent Ban Chargebacks Permanent Ban Staff Impersonation Temporary Ban Server Attacks Permanent Ban Inappropriate Builds Removal + Punishment

Note

Punishments are guidelines and may be increased or reduced depending on severity, player history, evidence, and circumstances.

docs.title: Questions?
docs.text:
Not sure whether something is allowed?

Ask staff before doing it.

Contact Staff

docs.title: Custom Features
docs.text: ArteryX adds a collection of quality-of-life features that improve survival without changing the vanilla experience.

docs.title: 🦇 Bat Membranes
docs.text: Phantoms are disabled as a membrane source. Bats can drop Phantom Membranes instead, making them a renewable resource.

docs.title: 🏗️ Concrete Cauldron
docs.text: Right-click Concrete Powder on a Water Cauldron to instantly create Concrete.

docs.title: 🟢 Slime Cauldron
docs.text: Special Slime Cauldrons allow you to use Slime Blocks to age Copper.

docs.title: 🍯 Honey Cauldron
docs.text: Special Honey Cauldrons allow you to use Honey Blocks to wax Copper.

docs.title: 🟫 Mud Cauldron
docs.text: Right-click Dirt on a Water Cauldron to convert it into Mud.

docs.title: 💥 Confetti Creepers
docs.text:
Some Creepers become Confetti Creepers, preventing block damage from their explosion.

  • 30% chance
  • 50% reduced entity damage
  • No block damage

docs.title: 🐉 Dragon Rewards
docs.text: Every Ender Dragon has a 25% chance to drop an Elytra.

docs.title: 🪶 Husk Sand Drops
docs.text: Husks can drop Sand, making Sand renewable through mob farming.

docs.title: 🧟 Infested Villagers
docs.text:
Villagers affected by the Infested effect can transform into Zombie Villagers after a short period.

  • Minimum: 60 seconds
  • Maximum: 180 seconds

docs.title: 🖼️ Better Paintings
docs.text: Use a Stonecutter to choose between different Painting variants before placing them.

docs.title: 🖌️ Invisible Item Frames
docs.text: Use a Brush on an Item Frame to toggle its visibility.

docs.title: 🤫 Silent Mobs
docs.text:
Rename any mob:

Silence Me

or

silence_me

to permanently silence it.

docs.title: 🪚 Wooden Stonecutter
docs.text: The Stonecutter also works as a Sawmill, allowing more efficient wooden recipes.

docs.title: 📖 Auto Unlock Recipes
docs.text: All crafting recipes are unlocked automatically when you join.

docs.title: 🐺 Transfer Pets
docs.text: Safely transfer ownership of tamed pets to another player using leads.

docs.title: 🐣 Keep Baby Animals Small
docs.text:
Name a baby mob:

Keep Small

to keep it permanently small.

Rename it:

Grow

to allow it to become an adult.

docs.title: 🧱 Mini Blocks
docs.text: Wandering Traders can sell decorative Mini Blocks for builders.

docs.title: ⚒️ Craftable Horse Armor
docs.text: Horse Armor can be crafted instead of relying entirely on exploration and loot.

docs.title: 🪑 Craftable Saddles
docs.text: Saddles can be crafted, making them easier to obtain during survival.

docs.title: 🌱 Small Dripleaf
docs.text: Craft Small Dripleaf from Large Dripleaf for easier decoration and building.

docs.title: 🌸 Craftable Spore Blossoms
docs.text: Spore Blossoms can be crafted using Lilacs, Azalea Leaves, and Honeycombs.

docs.title: 🟨 Craftable Gilded Blackstone
docs.text: Gilded Blackstone can be crafted using Gold Ingots and Blackstone.

docs.title: ⛏️ Smeltable Raw Ore Blocks
docs.text: Raw Ore Blocks can be smelted directly into their respective Ore Blocks.

docs.title: 🔩 Unsticky Pistons
docs.text:
Right-click a piston with an Axe to remove slime from it.

Right-click a piston with a Slimeball to make it sticky.

docs.title: 🧪 XP Bottling
docs.text:
Store your experience using Glass Bottles.

  • Costs 10 XP to bottle
  • Returns 50 XP when the bottle is used
  • Sneak to bottle multiple bottles at once

docs.title: 🏆 Vanilla, But Better
docs.text: Every feature is designed to save time, make resources more accessible, and improve survival while keeping ArteryX feeling close to vanilla Minecraft.

docs.title: Flux Hopper
docs.text:
Flux Hoppers are upgraded hoppers designed to automate your farms and reduce manual work.

They collect nearby drops, transfer items faster than vanilla hoppers, and can send items directly into linked containers.

docs.title: 🔨 Crafting
docs.text:
Craft a Flux Hopper using the recipe below.

📷 Crafting Recipe

docs.title: 📈 Upgrade System
docs.text:
Each Flux Hopper can be upgraded.

Upgradeable stats include:

  • 📦 Transfer Amount
  • 🧲 Suction Radius
  • 🔗 Link Amount
  • 📍 Link Distance

Open the hopper menu after placing it to upgrade these stats.

docs.title: 🔗 Linking Containers
docs.text:
Flux Hoppers can connect directly to nearby storage.

Simply:

  1. Place your Flux Hopper.
  2. Open its menu.
  3. Click Links.
  4. Link nearby chests, barrels, or other containers.

This allows farms to stay fully automated without overflowing.

docs.title: 💰 Farm Automation
docs.text:
Flux Hoppers work perfectly with:

  • 🌾 Crop Farms
  • 🐄 Animal Farms
  • 👾 Forge Spawners
  • 🌳 Tree Farms

Pair them with Sell Wands for a complete automatic farming setup.

docs.title: ⭐ Why Use Flux Hoppers?
docs.text:
Compared to vanilla hoppers, Flux Hoppers offer:

  • Faster item transfer
  • Larger pickup radius
  • Container linking
  • Upgradeable performance
  • Better server performance
  • Cleaner automated farms

docs.title: 💡 Tips
docs.text:
• Upgrade the suction radius first for better collection.
  • Link multiple storage containers before increasing transfer speed.
  • Keep your hopper inside your claim to prevent griefing.

Money Making

Flux Hoppers become incredibly powerful when combined with Forge Spawners and Sell Wands, creating one of the best passive money methods on ArteryX.

docs.title: Making Money
docs.text: Whether you're just starting or building a massive empire, there are plenty of ways to earn money on ArteryX.

docs.title: 🌾 Farming
docs.text:
Build crop farms and sell your harvest using:

  • /shop
  • Sell Wands

The larger your farm, the more money you'll earn.

docs.title: ⛏️ Mining
docs.text:
Explore caves and gather valuable ores.

Sell your resources at:

/shop

or keep them for crafting and progression.

docs.title: 🐄 Mob Farms
docs.text:
Mob farms are one of the best long-term money makers.

Upgrade your farm with:

  • Forge Spawners
  • Flux Hoppers
  • Sell Wands

These three features work together to create a nearly automatic income.

docs.title: ⚡ Flux Hoppers
docs.text:
Flux Hoppers automatically collect nearby drops and move them into linked containers.

Perfect for:

  • Mob Farms
  • Crop Farms
  • Automatic Collection

Less manual work means more profit.

docs.title: 🪄 Sell Wands
docs.text:
Sell Wands instantly sell everything inside a chest.

Simply:

  1. Hold a Sell Wand.
  2. Right-click a container.
  3. Everything is sold instantly.

No moving items. No opening the shop. Just instant money.

docs.title: 🏪 Player Shops
docs.text:
Think your items are worth more than /shop?

Create your own player shop and sell directly to other players.

Popular resources often sell for much higher prices.

docs.title: ⚖️ Auction House
docs.text:
Sell rare or valuable items using:

/ah

The Auction House lets players bid or purchase items from one another.

Perfect for:

  • Rare Gear
  • Enchanted Items
  • Resources
  • Collectibles

docs.title: 📈 Shop Prices
docs.text:
The Server Shop is not completely static.

Some item prices may be:

  • 📈 Buffed
  • 📉 Nerfed

over time to help balance the economy and encourage players to explore different ways of making money.

docs.title: 💡 Best Money Setup
docs.text:
For the highest income, combine:

  • Forge Spawners
  • Flux Hoppers
  • Sell Wands

This creates a fast, efficient, and mostly automatic farming system.

Tip

Don't rely on just one income source. Farming, mining, player shops, and automatic farms together are the fastest way to become wealthy on ArteryX.

docs.title: 🏝️ OneBlock Islands
docs.text: Your island is the heart of your ArteryX journey. Build, expand, progress through OneBlock phases, create farms, and turn your island into an empire.

docs.title: 🧱 Creating Your Island
docs.text:
Create your island with:

/ob create

Every player starts with a 50 × 50 island.

Your island is your personal protected space where you can build, farm, automate, and progress without worrying about other players destroying your work.

docs.title: 📏 Island Upgrades
docs.text:
Need more room?

Use:

/ob upgrade

Your island starts at:

50 × 50

and can be upgraded all the way to:

250 × 250

Upgrading your island gives you more room for massive builds, farms, storage systems, mob farms, and automation.

Your upgraded island size also applies to your Nether and End islands.

docs.title: 🧱 OneBlock Phases
docs.text:
Your OneBlock changes as you progress through different phases.

View your unlocked phases with:

/ob phases

You can switch between any phases you have already unlocked, allowing you to return to previous phases whenever you need specific resources.

Progress through phases to unlock new blocks, ores, mobs, resources, and other content.

docs.title: ⚙️ Island Settings
docs.text:
Customize how your island works with:

/ob settings

Depending on your permissions and available settings, you can manage different island flags and gameplay options.

This is where you can control various interactions and island-related settings.

docs.title: 👥 Island Members
docs.text:
Playing alone isn't as fun.

Invite upto max 4 friends and build together on your island. Your island members can help with building, farms, automation, and progression.

Only invite players you trust.

docs.title: 🌀 Island Warp
docs.text:
Want players to visit your island?

Use:

/ob warp

Your island warp allows other players to visit your island without needing to manually navigate to it.

Perfect for showcasing your builds, shops, farms, or island projects.

docs.title: 📊 Island Level
docs.text:
Want to see how developed your island is?

Use:

/ob level

Your island level represents the value and progression of your island.

Build with valuable blocks, expand your island, and create impressive structures to increase your island level.

docs.title: 🔥 Nether Island
docs.text:
ArteryX also features a dedicated Nether island.

The Nether island is a void environment connected to your main island progression, giving you a dedicated space for Nether builds, farms, and resources.

Your Nether island uses the same size as your main island.

For example:

Overworld → 100 × 100
Nether    → 100 × 100

docs.title: 🐉 End Island
docs.text:
The End also has its own dedicated void island.

Use it for End progression, farms, builds, and late-game projects.

Just like the Nether, its size matches your main island:

Overworld → 150 × 150
Nether    → 150 × 150
End       → 150 × 150

Upgrade your island to increase the available space across your dimensions.

docs.title: 🛡️ Island Protection
docs.text:
Your island is protected from unauthorized players.

Other players cannot freely:

  • ❌ Break your blocks
  • ❌ Place blocks
  • ❌ Destroy your builds
  • ❌ Steal from your island
  • ❌ Interfere with your farms

You control who can access and interact with your island.

docs.title: 🎒 Keep Inventory
docs.text:
Keep Inventory is disabled on ArteryX.

Dying can cause you to lose the items you're carrying, so store valuable resources safely before taking unnecessary risks.

docs.title: 🚀 Your OneBlock Journey
docs.text:
🧱 Create your island
       ↓
⛏️ Break your OneBlock
       ↓
🔓 Unlock new phases
       ↓
📏 Upgrade your island
       ↓
🌾 Build farms
       ↓
⚡ Automate your resources
       ↓
📊 Increase your island level
       ↓
🔥 Progress through the Nether
       ↓
🐉 Reach the End
       ↓
🏰 Build your empire

Useful Commands

`/ob` — View available OneBlock commands  
`/ob create` — Create your island  
`/ob settings` — Manage island settings and flags  
`/ob phases` — View and switch between unlocked phases  
`/ob upgrade` — Upgrade your island size  
`/ob warp` — Manage your island warp  
`/ob level` — View your island level

Island Size

Islands start at 50 × 50 and can be upgraded up to **250 × 250**. Your Nether and End islands follow the same size.

Death

Keep Inventory is disabled. Store valuable items before heading into dangerous areas.

docs.title: Seasons
docs.text:
ArteryX features a fully dynamic Season System that changes the world throughout the year.

Each season brings unique weather, lighting, particles, decorations, mob behavior, and exclusive rewards—making survival feel fresh every time you play.

docs.title: 🌎 Seasonal Cycle
docs.text:
The world automatically rotates through four unique seasons.

🌸 Spring

Life returns as nature awakens across the world.

  • Flowers bloom across the landscape
  • Fireflies appear after sunset
  • Bees and passive animals spawn more frequently
  • Pleasant weather
☀️ Summer

Bright days, warm nights, and clear skies.

  • Longest daytime of the year
  • Higher chance of clear weather
  • Shooting stars appear at night
  • Husks replace Zombies
🍂 Autumn

The world transforms with vibrant autumn colours.

  • Falling leaves
  • Leaf litter beneath trees
  • More Foxes and Bats
  • Pumpkin-wearing mobs
❄️ Winter

Snow blankets the world as temperatures drop.

  • Snowfall across the world
  • Cold breath particles
  • Short days and long nights
  • Strays replace Skeletons

docs.title: 🕒 Day & Night Length
docs.text:
Unlike vanilla Minecraft, every season has different daylight hours.

Season Day Night 🌸 Spring Medium Medium ☀️ Summer Long Short 🍂 Autumn Medium Medium ❄️ Winter Short Long

docs.title: ✨ Seasonal Effects
docs.text:
Throughout the year you'll notice:

  • 🍃 Falling Leaves
  • ✨ Fireflies
  • ☄️ Shooting Stars
  • ❄️ Cold Breath
  • 🌳 Seasonal Tree Colors
  • 🍂 Leaf Litter
  • 🌦 Dynamic Weather
  • 🌎 Seasonal Ambience

docs.title: 👾 Seasonal Mobs
docs.text:
Some creatures become more common depending on the current season.

Season Changes 🌸 Spring More Bees & passive mobs ☀️ Summer Husks replace Zombies 🍂 Autumn More Foxes & Bats, Pumpkin mobs ❄️ Winter Strays replace Skeletons

docs.title: 🎁 Seasonal Crates
docs.text:
Every season introduces its own exclusive crate.

At the beginning of each new season, every player receives:

🎁 1 Seasonal Crate Key

Current seasonal crates include:

  • 🌸 Spring Crate
  • ☀️ Summer Crate
  • 🍂 Autumn Crate
  • ❄️ Winter Crate

Each crate contains exclusive seasonal rewards that are only available during that season.

Open them anytime at:

/warp crates

docs.title: 🎉 Seasonal Events
docs.text: Special events automatically activate during holidays.

docs.title: 🎃 Halloween
docs.text:
• Stronger hostile mobs
  • Pumpkin enemies
  • Flaming Skeletons
  • Special Halloween atmosphere

docs.title: 🎄 Christmas
docs.text:
• Christmas decorations
  • Presents around villages
  • Holiday announcements
  • Exclusive festive rewards

docs.title: 🎆 New Year
docs.text:
• Firework celebrations
  • Village festivities
  • Limited-time surprises

docs.title: 🚀 More Coming Soon
docs.text:
The Seasons system will continue to expand with future updates.

Planned additions include:

  • 🎁 New Seasonal Rewards
  • 🧩 Seasonal Quests
  • 👒 Exclusive Cosmetics
  • 🏆 Community Events
  • 🎊 Limited-Time Activities

Every season is designed to make ArteryX feel like a brand new world.

docs.title: Sell Wands
docs.text:
Sell Wands instantly sell everything inside a chest with a single click.

They're one of the biggest quality-of-life features on ArteryX.

docs.title: How to Use
docs.text:
1. Hold a Sell Wand.
  2. Right-click a container.
  3. Everything inside is sold instantly.

No need to manually sell items anymore.

docs.title: Tiers
docs.text: There are 3 Sell Wand tiers.

docs.title: 🪵 Stick Sell Wand
docs.text:
Perfect for beginners.

Uses:

  • 5
  • 25
  • 50

docs.title: 🌬️ Breeze Sell Wand
docs.text:
Great for growing farms.

Uses:

  • 75
  • 150
  • 250

docs.title: 🔥 Blaze Sell Wand
docs.text:
Built for large automatic farms.

Uses:

  • 500
  • 750
  • 1000

docs.title: Crafting
docs.text:
Players can craft a beginner Sell Wand with:

✅ 5 Uses

docs.title: Crates
docs.text:
Higher tier Sell Wands can be obtained from:

  • Common Crates
  • Rare Crates
  • Epic Crates
  • Legendary Crates

docs.title: Selling Prices
docs.text:
Sell Wands use the exact same prices as:

/shop

They simply save time by selling everything instantly.

Tip

Pair Sell Wands with Flux Hoppers and Forge Spawners to create one of the most efficient money-making setups on the server.

docs.title: Forge Spawners
docs.text:
Forge Spawners are one of the fastest ways to build fully automated farms and generate a steady income.

Unlike vanilla, every player can eventually obtain and move spawners.

docs.title: 🛒 Getting a Spawner
docs.text: There are two ways to obtain a spawner.

docs.title: ⛏ Mine One
docs.text: Spawners can be mined using a Silk Touch Pickaxe.

docs.title: 💰 Buy One
docs.text:
Purchase any spawner directly using:

/spawner get

Price:

$75,000

docs.title: ⚡ Upgrading Your Farm
docs.text:
Spawners become even more powerful when combined with:

  • ⚙ Flux Hoppers
  • 💸 Sell Wands
  • 📦 Large Storage Systems

This allows you to create completely automated money farms.

docs.title: 📦 Supported Mobs
docs.text:
Most vanilla mob spawners are supported.

Common choices include:

  • Zombie
  • Skeleton
  • Spider
  • Blaze
  • Breeze
  • Cave Spider
  • Pig
  • Cow
  • Chicken
  • Sheep

More mob types may become available through future updates.

docs.title: 💡 Tips
docs.text:
• Place your spawners inside a claimed area.
  • Use Flux Hoppers to automatically collect drops.
  • Use Sell Wands to instantly sell your farm's loot.
  • Upgrade your farm over time for maximum profit.

Best Combo

Forge Spawner + Flux Hopper + Sell Wand = One of the easiest ways to earn money on ArteryX.
